description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Wind 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Holy 2 with Stacking] based on element of entry damage, [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode] and [Zenith Mode: Angeal] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Angeal
description.text: Increases [Wind/Holy Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Wind or Holy abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Angeal after using two Wind or Holy abilities (max 1), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Wings of Pride+
description.text: 3/5 single attacks (1.10 each) if the user hasn't/has any Damage Reduction Barrier, grants [40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1] to the user

description.name: Unleashed Wrath+
description.text: Four single attacks (1.20/1.25 each), followed by one single attack (1.20/1.25) with additional 20% critical damage, capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Spirit Attack: Angeal
description.text: Grants [Weakness +30% Boost 3] to user/all allies with 0-3/4+ Knight allies in the party

description.name: Attach Wind 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Attach Holy 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
